title: Silencing Empowerment, Allowing Bigotry: Auditing the Moderation of Hate Speech on Twitch

bias_targets.methodology: Sending hate speech comments targeting mentally and physically disabled individuals to a Twitch live chat sandbox and measuring the moderation recall and precision of AutoMod's Disability filter.

Evaluating the moderation effectiveness of Twitch's AutoMod at filtering hate speech targeted at racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, Asian, Latino, Indigenous folks) using benchmark datasets, analysis of pre-filtered messages, and counterfactual slur substitutions.

Measuring the true positive rate of Twitch's AutoMod on hateful comments directed at religious groups (e.g., Jewish and Muslim folks) by programmatically sending messages and analyzing moderation event triggers.

Auditing Twitch's moderation system by passing text samples containing misogynistic and misandrist hate speech and evaluating the performance, precision, and contextual awareness of the system's Misogyny filter.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Testing the moderation rates of Twitch's AutoMod on homophobic and transphobic hate speech using the SSG (Sex, Sexuality, and Gender) filter, and evaluating the system's policy adherence by testing empowering and pedagogical statements about the LGBTQ+ community.
